evidence.quote:
Every new hire completes the Pallasine checklist in their first
week

observations.why: Mandating a structured first-week checklist appeals to stability/order (conservation) and mastery-readiness (competence), but the value language is procedural rather than explicitly value-named.

evidence.quote:
It replaced the
old wiki page last quarter.

observations.why: Framing the checklist as a replacement for a prior system appeals to keeping what works / institutional continuity, but the motive is thin and factual rather than value-laden.
